## Structure and components

- [statement] The buntanetap Phase 3 study in early PD did not meet its primary endpoint of MDS-UPDRS Part II, according to the published paper and Alzforum. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://www.nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap
- [statement] The original primary endpoint of the buntanetap early-PD study was the sum of MDS-UPDRS Part II and Part III; the paper and the sponsor release state it was changed to MDS-UPDRS Part II per FDA guidance or feedback. (high confidence) — https://www.nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1477845/000110465924077093/tm2418712d1_ex99-1.htm, https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap
- [statement] In its press release the sponsor reported statistical improvement in MDS-UPDRS Part II, Part III, Part II+III and Total scores in Parkinson’s patients with a >3-year diagnosis; Fierce Biotech reports this subgroup as 158 participants. (medium confidence) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1477845/000110465924077093/tm2418712d1_ex99-1.htm · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/annovis-glosses-over-primary-endpoint-pivotal-parkinsons-data-focuses-subgroups-and

## How it works

- [statement] Alzforum states the company did not report on the primary endpoint in the group as a whole when it announced results on July 2, 2024; Fierce Biotech says the release skirted the question of whether buntanetap moved the needle on the main goal. (high confidence) — https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/annovis-glosses-over-primary-endpoint-pivotal-parkinsons-data-focuses-subgroups-and
- [statement] In the phase 1b study of anle138b in PD (NCT04685265), the conference abstract reports 70 participants were enrolled in cohorts A-E and that anle138b was safe and well tolerated when administered 7-28 days; the registry lists 70 actual participants. (medium confidence) — https://www.mdsabstracts.org/abstract/anle138b-p1-02-a-randomised-double-blinded-placebo-controlled-phase-1b-study-to-investigate-safety-tolerability-pharmacokinetics-and-pharmacodynamics-of-the-oligomer-modulator-anle138b-in-parkins/ · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT04685265

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The buntanetap Phase 3 study in early PD (registry NCT05357989) enrolled 523 participants in a 6-month, randomized, double-blind, dose-ranging design testing 10 mg and 20 mg buntanetap against placebo. (high confidence) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT05357989 · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x, https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap
- [statement] A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 1a trial of anle138b in healthy volunteers enrolled 68 participants and reported exposure levels above the fully effective exposure in the MI2 mouse Parkinson model at multiple doses of 200 mg. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9065877/ · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap
- [statement] Alzforum reports that in January 2026 a Phase 2/3 study began to enroll 500 Parkinson’s patients for a three-year, open-label safety study of 30 mg daily buntanetap. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-02-10) — https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] UCB announced on 16 December 2024 that ORCHESTRA, a study of minzasolmin, an oral small-molecule alpha-synuclein misfolding inhibitor, did not meet its primary and secondary clinical endpoints in early Parkinson’s disease. (high confidence) — https://www.ucb.com/newsroom/press-releases/article/findings-from-minzasolmin-proof-of-concept-orchestra-study-shape-next-steps-in-ucb-parkinson-s-research-program · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/minzasolmin

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] ORCHESTRA (NCT04658186) was a Phase 2a, randomised, placebo-controlled, 18-month study of oral minzasolmin at 180mg/day or 360mg/day versus placebo in early-stage Parkinson’s disease, with primary endpoint progression in the MDS-UPDRS Parts I–III sum score. (high confidence) — https://www.ucb.com/newsroom/press-releases/article/findings-from-minzasolmin-proof-of-concept-orchestra-study-shape-next-steps-in-ucb-parkinson-s-research-program · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/minzasolmin

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Buntanetap, formerly Posiphen, is described as a small molecule that inhibits translation of aggregation-prone proteins including APP, tau and α-synuclein; Alzforum notes Posiphen reportedly blocks translation of α-synuclein mRNA. (high confidence) — https://www.nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap
- [statement] The paper reports that buntanetap improved cognition in a post-hoc analysis, with nominally statistically significant dose-dependent benefits in amyloid-positive PD patients with mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia; Alzforum notes MMSE was not listed as a study outcome. (high confidence) — https://www.nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap
- [statement] Two sources give different sizes for the buntanetap subgroup with MMSE scores of 20 to 28: Alzforum reports 173 patients and the paper reports 182 participants. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/buntanetap · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x
- [statement] UCB states it has initiated measures to terminate the extension phase of the minzasolmin program, and Alzforum and the Michael J. Fox Foundation state that the companies terminated the long-term extension or do not plan to continue testing. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://www.ucb.com/newsroom/press-releases/article/findings-from-minzasolmin-proof-of-concept-orchestra-study-shape-next-steps-in-ucb-parkinson-s-research-program · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/minzasolmin, https://www.michaeljfox.org/news/news-context-mixed-results-two-experimental-drugs-targeting-alpha-synuclein
- [statement] The Michael J. Fox Foundation interview states the ORCHESTRA trial was launched before the alpha-synuclein seed amplification assay existed, so it is not known for sure that enrolled participants had the misfolded alpha-synuclein pathology the drug targeted. (low confidence) — https://www.michaeljfox.org/news/news-context-mixed-results-two-experimental-drugs-targeting-alpha-synuclein · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap
- [statement] The primary outcomes registered for the anle138b phase 1b study (NCT04685265) are safety measures such as incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events, and the conference abstract states efficacy trials in patients with synucleinopathies are planned. (medium confidence) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT04685265 · keywords: Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap · also: https://www.mdsabstracts.org/abstract/anle138b-p1-02-a-randomised-double-blinded-placebo-controlled-phase-1b-study-to-investigate-safety-tolerability-pharmacokinetics-and-pharmacodynamics-of-the-oligomer-modulator-anle138b-in-parkins/

## Research summary — Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap

Covers three alpha-synuclein-directed small molecules: buntanetap (a translation inhibitor), minzasolmin (a misfolding inhibitor) and anle138b (an oligomer modulator). Buntanetap's Phase 3 early-PD study did not meet its primary endpoint per the paper and Alzforum; its cognition findings are post hoc. UCB announced that ORCHESTRA did not meet primary or secondary endpoints and began ending the minzasolmin extension. Anle138b has reported phase 1 safety data, with efficacy trials described as planned.

## Source disagreement — Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap

The sponsor release says its results met both primary and secondary endpoints in the specified subgroups, while the paper states the study did not meet its primary endpoint of MDS-UPDRS Part II.
